name: bandit.phase4_decoy_empty_signal_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live decoy control. A real idle five-member camp receives one fresh returned-report smoke lead at a fixed road OMT where no physical smoke or same-source typed support exists. Production must dispatch its exact pair, inspect only that uncertainty area, mark the lead stale/empty, return home, and never substitute the avatar location.

steps.label: settle_phase4_decoy_fixture
steps.expected_visible_fact: the five-member decoy fixture reaches normal gameplay

steps.label: preflight_fresh_returned_smoke_decoy
steps.abort_reason: fixture did not contain one fresh returned smoke lead and an otherwise idle ready camp
steps.expected_immediate_state: one non-player returned smoke clue points only to road OMT 136,51,0 before production dispatch

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_decoy_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the real scheduler dispatches exactly one pair toward the decoy uncertainty OMT
steps.failure_rule: A missing dispatch or a player target makes the decoy row red.

steps.label: audit_exact_decoy_dispatch
steps.abort_reason: same-run maintenance did not dispatch the camp-owned returned smoke lead
steps.expected_immediate_state: the exact pair is committed to the fixed signal OMT without an avatar token

steps.label: audit_decoy_dispatch_has_no_player_token
steps.abort_reason: the decoy dispatch contained an avatar-coordinate target
steps.expected_immediate_state: dispatch identity and target contain only camp/lead/source provenance

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_decoy_stalking_check
steps.expected_visible_fact: the pair performs its ordinary route-side stalking check without changing the decoy target

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_decoy_empty_arrival
steps.expected_visible_fact: the pair reaches only OMT 136,51,0 and records the unsupported signal as empty/stale
steps.failure_rule: The row is red if arrival invents a replacement location or retains confidence without support.

steps.label: audit_decoy_empty_transition
steps.abort_reason: same-run arrival did not record the unsupported signal investigation as empty
steps.expected_immediate_state: the real outing is returning home from the unchanged uncertainty OMT

steps.label: open_decoy_arrival_ecology_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the normal overmap opens with the ecology overlay after empty arrival

steps.label: select_decoy_returning_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the returning dispatch is selected at the original decoy OMT, not at the player

steps.label: close_decoy_arrival_overmap
steps.expected_visible_fact: the overmap closes with the returning dispatch selected

steps.label: open_decoy_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the existing ecology console opens for the selected returning pair

steps.label: arm_decoy_return_watch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the selected phase-change watch binds the real returning dispatch

steps.label: record_decoy_empty_incident
steps.expected_visible_fact: an atomic natural-provenance incident pair records the empty-return state and fixed destination

steps.label: close_decoy_ecology_console
steps.expected_visible_fact: the console closes before the physical return wait

steps.label: wait_final_1_hour_for_decoy_pair_return
steps.expected_visible_fact: the exact pair physically returns while the decoy lead stays stale

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_decoy_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player mtime baseline is recorded before final writeback

steps.label: open_save_prompt_after_decoy_return
steps.abort_reason: save-and-quit prompt was not visibly proven after decoy return
steps.expected_visible_fact: the case-sensitive save-and-quit prompt is open

steps.label: confirm_save_after_decoy_return
steps.expected_visible_fact: uppercase Y confirms the proven final save prompt

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_decoy_save
steps.abort_reason: saved-player mtime did not advance after decoy return
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run empty-lead outcome was written to disk

steps.label: audit_saved_decoy_lead_stale_and_pair_home
steps.abort_reason: saved owner did not retain the exact stale zero-confidence smoke lead with the full pair home
steps.expected_immediate_state: the camp retains one honest stale clue at the original OMT and no active pressure

steps.label: audit_decoy_lifecycle_has_no_player_token
steps.abort_reason: the decoy lifecycle exposed an avatar-coordinate target
steps.expected_immediate_state: all decoy provenance stays on the returned clue and fixed road OMT

evidence_contract.claim: one real bandit pair investigates a staged but schema-valid returned smoke clue, finds no physical/same-source support at its fixed uncertainty OMT, writes the lead stale with zero confidence, and returns without learning the player location
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: the returned-report smoke lead and DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE mutation are explicit fixture footing; no active outing, route, arrival, empty result, stale state, return, or replacement target is injected
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: The same run must contain a natural-provenance ecology_incident JSON/PNG pair for the returning dispatch at the decoy OMT with an empty intervention ledger; coordinator inspection is authoritative for that payload.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No credit if the exact pair does not dispatch/arrive/return, if the lead is not saved stale and zero-confidence, if target OMT changes, or if player@ appears in the signal lifecycle.
